ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) base pixels across roughly 90% of the visible surface, punctuated by high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters resulting in a high local contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark-pixel background with discrete, high-contrast white circular and punctate blobs (rosette scars) distributed semi-randomly; larger white contiguous patches are visible adjacent to the median notch and on the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior angle and a depth-to-width ratio indicating high prominence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe exhibits high-frequency, jagged serrations with variable amplitudes; left lobe features a distinctive large-scale U-shaped notch on the inner trailing edge and lower-frequency irregularities toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a concave curve from the median notch toward the distal tips, which exhibit an upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of roughly circular, high-contrast white rings and solid spots (scars) across the entire visible ventral surface, particularly concentrated in the mid-lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, vertical, high-contrast white linear streaks are visible on the lower section of the left lobe, cutting across the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, deep semi-circular indentation (likely trauma-induced) is located on the trailing edge of the left lobe, near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity, calcified barnacle clusters along the extreme outer edges (distal tips) of both the left and right lobes.
